title: Are you doing biceps curls wrong? 💪
caption:
Palms up to work the biceps hardest, elbows still, slow on the way down, full stretch at the bottom. If you have to swing it, it is too heavy. How heavy do you curl? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 11
first_comment: Ego curlers swinging 30 kg: we see you 👀
